mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `claim` (item_id, claimant_openid, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{claimantOpenid}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, i.title AS item_title, i.type AS item_type, i.publisher_openid FROM `claim` c LEFT JOIN `item` i ON c.item_id = i.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `claim` SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
